## Projects

### Strokeshare (2025)
A responsive, high-performance web drawing app (Next.js + React + Konva) with infinite canvas, shape/text/image tools, undo/redo, and export to PNG/SVG/JSON (.str).

**Key Details:**
- Polished, production-oriented web drawing application demonstrating complex interactive browser experiences
- Built with Next.js and React with TypeScript for responsive UI
- Uses Konva/react-konva for GPU-accelerated canvas performance
- Supports freehand drawing, shapes (rectangles/circles/arrows), text editing, image import, pan/zoom
- Transformer-based selection UX for moving/resizing objects
- Robust undo/redo history persisted to localStorage
- Full canvas import/export (PNG, SVG, and structured .str project format)
- Export pipeline with optional background rendering and embedded images
- File System Access API with fallbacks for seamless save/load across browsers
- Centralized Zustand store for deterministic state and history management
- Custom eraser computing proximity to lines/shapes for accurate erasure
- Performant serialization to SVG with image defs
- Modular UI built from Radix + Tailwind primitives for accessibility

**Tech Stack:** Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind, Shadcn UI, React Konva, Vitest  
**Links:** [Live](https://strokeshare.zytact.com) | [GitHub](https://github.com/zytact/strokeshare)

---

### Inventrack (2025)
An AI-powered, full‑stack inventory management dashboard built with Next.js and TypeScript that gives small retailers real‑time stock visibility, AI demand forecasts, automated expiry & restock handling, and dynamic pricing recommendations.

**Key Details:**
- Production‑ready inventory web app for small stores with real‑time inventory, purchases, sales, expired‑stock tracking, and category management
- AI‑first features with integrated LLM pipeline (server route to Gemini) powering stock‑level recommendations, product discontinuation suggestions, and AI‑driven dynamic pricing
- Postgres schema with drizzle-orm implementing multi‑tenant data isolation (users, items, sold_items, purchases, expired_items, sales_reports)
- Full stack serverless architecture with Next.js App Router route handlers
- Designed for serverless deployment (Neon Postgres + Vercel)
- Polished responsive UI with TailwindCSS + Shadcn UI components
- Interactive tables and charts (Recharts) with focused dashboard
- Client/server sync using @tanstack/react-query for caching and optimistic updates
- Authentication and session management with Clerk
- Reusable component library with modular UI components and domain hooks
- TypeScript across the stack with linting and drizzle-kit for migrations

**Tech Stack:** Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind, Shadcn UI, TanStack Query, Clerk, Drizzle ORM, PostgreSQL, AI  
**Links:** [Live](https://inventrack.zytact.com) | [GitHub](https://github.com/zytact/inventrack)

---

### Compress (2026)
A fast, privacy-focused image compression and resizing tool that runs entirely in your browser using WebAssembly. No data is sent to any server—all processing happens locally on your device.

**Key Details:**
- Solves pain of oversized or incompatible images by resizing, compressing, and converting entirely in browser
- No server uploads—preserves privacy and speed
- Key features: resize by exact dimensions or target file size, adjustable JPEG quality, format conversion (JPEG ↔ PNG), HEIC/HEIF to JPEG conversion
- Live before/after previews with optimized one-click downloads
- Core image processing written in Rust and compiled to WebAssembly
- Uses high-quality Lanczos3 resampling and binary search to hit target file sizes
- Modern frontend with TanStack Start, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4
- Clean, responsive, component-driven interface with instant visual feedback
- Privacy-first: all image decoding, resizing, compression happens locally via browser APIs and WASM

**Tech Stack:** TanStack Start, TypeScript, Tailwind, Rust, WASM  
**Links:** [Live](https://compress.zytact.com) | [GitHub](https://github.com/zytact/compress)

---

### Exif Tuner (2024)
A privacy-first web app to view, batch-edit, and download EXIF metadata on JPEG images directly in the browser, built with Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and piexifjs.

**Key Details:**
- Solves pain of incorrect or missing EXIF metadata by inspecting and updating date/time, GPS coordinates, and camera make/model
- No server uploads required—all processing client-side
- Key features: client-side EXIF read/write, batch processing, image preview carousel, form validation, one-click downloads preserving image quality
- Uses FileReader + data-URLs for image handling, piexifjs for EXIF manipulation
- Robust UX with form validation via zod + react-hook-form
- Organized tabs for Date & Time / GPS / Camera metadata
- Responsive component-based UI built with Tailwind CSS and accessible primitives
- Privacy-first: all processing in browser—no server-side uploads or storage

**Tech Stack:** Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind, Piexif JS, Zod  
**Links:** [Live](https://exiftuner.zytact.com) | [GitHub](https://github.com/zytact/ExifTuner)

---

### Jiyu (2020)
A polished Flutter anime-tracker (Android-first) that syncs a locally stored watchlist with Firebase, supports Google sign-in, and presents a fast, dark-themed grid UI for tracking Watching / Completed / Dropped series.

**Key Details:**
- Lightweight, offline-capable mobile app for anime fans to track progress
- Quickly update episodes watched and preserve library with cloud backups
- Core features: add anime entries, increment watched episodes, move items to Completed or Dropped, delete entries, view total watch time
- Restore/save backups to Firebase Storage for data preservation across devices
- Single codebase with Flutter and Dart (targeting Android; iOS instructions included)
- End-to-end Google Sign-In using Firebase Auth with StreamBuilder-based auth flow
- Reliable offline-first storage using sqflite (SQLite) with clear DB models and CRUD helpers
- Cloud sync via Firebase Storage for backup/restore
- Dark theme with responsive staggered grid layout (flutter_staggered_grid_view)
- Hero transitions, pull-to-refresh, and thoughtful UX (increment button, long-press actions, user account drawer)
- Asynchronous patterns with FutureBuilder, StreamBuilder, async/await

**Tech Stack:** Flutter, Dart, Jikan API, Firebase  
**Links:** [GitHub](https://github.com/zytact/Jiyu)

---

### RustCharge (2025)
Rustcharge is a compact, cross-platform battery monitor written in Rust that sends desktop notifications and plays custom sounds when your battery crosses configurable thresholds.

**Key Details:**
- Lightweight CLI tool monitoring system battery and notifying when charge crosses user-defined percentages
- Prevents overcharging or unexpected shutdowns
- Key features: real-time monitoring, configurable thresholds (--above, --below), adjustable poll interval (--sec)
- Optional disabling of high/low alerts (--no-above, --no-below)
- Custom notification sounds (--sound-path) and urgency control on Linux (--urgency)
- Small, modular Rust codebase with polling loop
- Utilities for battery reading (battery crate) and audio playback (rodio)
- Idiomatic Rust using battery, notify-rust, rodio, and clap
- Simple design prioritizing low resource usage—periodic loop checks battery state

**Tech Stack:** Rust  
**Links:** [GitHub](https://github.com/zytact/RustCharge)

---

### Tsukuyomi (2025)
Tsukuyomi — a lightweight, privacy-first browser extension (React + TypeScript) that lets users manually suspend tabs to free memory and speed up their browser.

**Key Details:**
- Solves browser bloat by suspending inactive tabs on demand
- Keeps tabs available while drastically reducing memory footprint
- Clean, focused UI listing open tabs with favicons and titles
- Supports single-click suspension and Shift+click range suspension for bulk cleanup
- Cross‑browser compatibility handling Chrome and Firefox extension API differences
- Privacy-first: works entirely offline with no telemetry or tracking
- Modern web tooling: React 19, TypeScript, Vite, Bun-friendly scripts, Tailwind

**Tech Stack:** TypeScript, React  
**Links:** [GitHub](https://github.com/zytact/tsukuyomi)

## Development Philosophy

- **Privacy-first:** Multiple projects emphasize client-side processing to keep user data private
- **Build in public:** Sharing the journey, not just the destination
- **Knowledge sharing:** Contributing back to the community through open source
- **Clean architecture:** Maintainable, well-structured code
- **User-centered:** Products that solve real problems

## Tech Stack (This Website)

- **Framework:** Next.js 16 with App Router
- **Language:** TypeScript (strict mode)
- **Styling:** Tailwind CSS v4
- **UI:** shadcn/ui (Radix UI primitives)
- **Animation:** Motion (Framer Motion successor)
- **Fonts:** Geist Sans & Geist Mono
- **Theme:** Dark/Light mode support
